clips.title: The story
paras: Call of Fire sends an initiate through the winds of Skywall to seek out Olariaan Swiftburn, a shen'dorei Windshaper attuned to the element of fire. By bringing the Torch of Dormant Flame to the Shrine of Flames in the Gustberry Lowlands, the traveler begins learning to heed the call of the flame even within the domain of air.

Even within Skywall, the domain ruled by the air elementals, the broader currents of the Elemental Plane remain connected. The spirits of earth, water, and fire still speak to those with the sensitivity to hear them. The Windshapers count among their fellowship individuals uniquely receptive to these other forces, including Olariaan Swiftburn, a shen'dorei who fosters a deep attunement with the element of fire.

Initiates are entrusted with the Torch of Dormant Flame and directed toward the Gustberry Lowlands. Far out along the island rim, tucked west of Valanaar, stands the Shrine of Flames. There, Olariaan Swiftburn receives the dormant flame, offering to instruct aspiring students in answering the demanding call of fire amidst the churning currents of the air realm.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Even though we are in the realm of Skywall, this is still the elemental plane. The spirits of all four elements speak to us, if we deign to listen. One among us Windshapers is in particular attunement with the element of fire. A shen'dorei by the name of Olariaan Swiftburn.
Bring this to him at the Shrine of Flames in the Gustberry Lowlands. You'll find it tucked away along the edge of the island, west of Valanaar.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Yes, friend? What do you have there?

clips.title: Completion
paras: So you've brought the torch. Yes, young adventurer, I can teach you to heed the call of fire. It will not be easy, but nothing that we do in this realm is ever easy.
